verdict.rationale: There is no direct evidence of flow-to-flow calls. The closest support is that flows can be handed to AI agents as reusable tools [docs-15, docs-42], and developers can build custom TypeScript pieces that act as reusable modules across flows [docs-1]. Missing for 10: a documented sub-flow or call-flow step that lets one workflow invoke another, input/output contracts for called flows, versioning of shared modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
